body: Jonathan Kuminga is reported to prefer the Lakers to Minnesota, with a decision said to be coming soon. Still no signing, just another update on where his head is at.

Nikola Jovic's contract is being treated as a burden rather than a prize, according to Sportando. In trade discussions built around Klay Thompson, Dallas reportedly asked Miami for draft compensation just to take Jovic on. Nothing here is agreed, and no deal is described as close.

Three hypothetical trades are constructed around what Miami might accept for Nikola Jovic, framed on chatter that he has become a negative asset. No deal is in the works and no reporter is credited. Speculation built on invented scenarios rather than sourcing.

Insider Jake Fischer, speaking on a Bleacher Report live stream, said Bennedict Mathurin's restricted free agency looks like a two-option affair: a sign-and-trade to New Orleans or taking the qualifying offer from the Clippers. Nothing is agreed. This is speculation from one insider, not a deal in motion.

A proposed three-team deal would send Dalton Knecht and Jaden Hardy out of Los Angeles in exchange for an unnamed $46M NBA champion. It is projection rather than reporting: no sourcing is offered, no talks are described, and no team is confirmed as engaged.

Jake Fischer said on his Bleacher Report livestream that Jonathan Kuminga has narrowed his choice to the Lakers and Timberwolves. Both teams can only offer the veteran minimum unless a sign-and-trade is built, and Fischer laid out why that gets messy: Atlanta sits $3.8M from the tax and wouldn't want salary back, forcing a third team in, while Minnesota is $8.2M over the first apron. Fischer reported Kuminga favors the Lakers, possibly via a sign-and-trade that would require a third team to absorb Jarred Vanderbilt or Dalton Knecht. Nothing is agreed.

A hypothetical multi-team trade would land Jimmy Butler with the Hawks and Jonathan Kuminga with the Bucks. No sourcing or reporter is attached to the idea. It is speculation rather than anything in motion.

A proposed deal would move Pistons big man Jalen Duren to the Bucks. Duren is described as a restricted free agent. This is a speculative exercise rather than a reported negotiation, with no sourcing attached.

The Lakers are said to be looking for a third team to help make a Jonathan Kuminga sign-and-trade with Golden State work. No framework or names beyond that were laid out. Treat it as speculation until someone puts sourcing behind it.

A handful of trade threads get bundled together: Kyrie Irving's situation, the Knicks' decision on Mikal Bridges, and renewed Lakers chatter around Jonathan Kuminga. No specifics or named sourcing are offered in the item. Treat it as speculation.

Jonathan Kuminga and the Lakers would solve each other's problems, the argument goes: Los Angeles desperately needs an athletic wing, and Kuminga is an athletic wing desperate to prove himself on a bigger stage. No deal is reported and no sources are cited. Treat it as opinion, not a transaction.

Five teams are floated as clubs that should be monitoring Kyrie Irving amid what the piece describes as recent trade chatter. There is no sourcing, no reported talks and no named executives. It is a list piece built on speculation rather than any reported movement.

A hypothetical three-player deal would send Kevin Durant from Houston to New York. There is no reporting of actual talks attached to it. It's a proposed trade concept, not a negotiation. Treat it as speculation.

Other teams are reportedly keeping tabs on Kyrie Irving's contract situation, hoping to pry him away from Dallas. The item lists no offers, no numbers and no named sourcing. Just interest. Treat it as speculation until someone attaches a name to it.

The Lakers and Hawks remain in negotiations over a Jonathan Kuminga sign-and-trade, according to the report. No terms, no timeline, and the item itself questions whether anything actually gets done. Treat it as speculation until someone attaches names and numbers to it.

A proposed two-team trade would send Pistons center Jalen Duren to the Celtics. There is no reporting of actual talks between Detroit and Boston. Treat it as a proposal, not a rumor with named sourcing.

A proposed scenario would have the Lakers involve Jaden Hardy in sign-and-trade discussions for Jonathan Kuminga. No terms are attached, there is no named sourcing, and the item is framed as a question rather than a done deal. Speculation rather than reporting.

The Lakers' interest in Golden State forward Jonathan Kuminga is said to be running into a complication: Minnesota is reportedly interested as well. No terms or framework are described, and no named insider is attached. Speculation rather than reporting.

Another trade target has reportedly become available to the Lakers should a pursuit of Jonathan Kuminga collapse. The item is framed as a "dream" target, but the summary offers no names, terms or named sourcing. Treat it as speculation until someone puts a player and a price on it.

A proposed three-player deal would return Kyrie Irving to the Celtics from Dallas. No reporter is credited with sourcing, and no team interest is cited. This is a proposed scenario, not a reported negotiation.

A prediction has Houston trading for Anthony Davis to pair him with Kevin Durant. No reporter or team source is attached to the idea, and nothing indicates a deal is in motion. Projection rather than reporting. Davis, a former Lakers champion and future Hall of Famer, is on a $364M contract.

A hypothetical trade would land the Lakers a stretch power forward to play alongside Luka Doncic. It's a projection rather than a report. No named sourcing and no indication a deal is being discussed. Treat it as an idea rather than news.

An inactive offseason in Denver does little to lock in Nikola Jokic, who can reach free agency next summer, per a CBS Sports column that concedes he most likely stays put. Opinion and speculation rather than a reported move, with no named sourcing on Jokic's intentions.

Malique Lewis, taken by Milwaukee with the No. 60 pick, is expected to sign with the Cairns Taipans in Australia's NBL, making him a draft-and-stash for the Bucks. The 21-year-old averaged 6.9 points and 4.3 rebounds last season with the South East Melbourne Phoenix. No named sourcing is attached to the report.

League sources say Josh Hart and the Knicks could land on a three-year extension in the $54-62 million range, per a report citing two separate sources. Hart became extension-eligible on August 10, with a maximum of four years and $132 million available. He is entering the final guaranteed season of his deal at $20.9 million, with a team option near $22 million for 2027-28. Nothing is agreed yet, and the report notes comparables such as Derrick White's salary and Dillon Brooks' three-year, $73 million extension suggest Hart could push higher.

Klay Thompson with the Lakers and Jonathan Kuminga with the Cavaliers are among the hypothetical landing spots raised in a canvass of scouts on where players might best fit. It is speculation about fit rather than reporting of any active talks, and no named front-office sourcing is attached. Treat it as a thought exercise.

The Cavaliers are reportedly looking into a secondary trade that would serve as a stepping stone toward a larger deal. No players, teams or terms are attached to the item. Treat it as speculation until sourcing and specifics surface.

Houston guard Reed Sheppard has been identified as one of the more attractive trade targets around the league. No specific deal or suitor is attached to the chatter, so this remains speculation rather than an active negotiation.

A Yahoo Sports rumor roundup touches on Stephen Curry's long-term outlook with Golden State ahead of the 2026 offseason, along with an update on Klay Thompson. No concrete move is reported, and the item is speculative in nature. Treat it as early offseason chatter rather than a reported transaction.

A Yahoo Sports piece raises the possibility that Stephen Curry could eventually seek a trade out of Golden State late in his career if his frustration with the franchise's direction deepens. This is speculation rather than a reported request, and no talks have been indicated. Curry has spent his entire career with the Warriors.

A report links the Lakers to potential trades for Wizards big man Daniel Gafford and Mavericks forward P.J. Washington. Los Angeles has been searching for frontcourt help, though nothing appears imminent. Treat this as speculation until a deal is formally reported.

Trade speculation continues to surround Dallas forward P.J. Washington, according to a Yahoo Sports item citing an NBA insider update. No specific deal or suitor was detailed in the report. For now this remains speculation rather than an agreed move.

Washington faces a contract decision on Anthony Davis, having already committed to a large extension for Trae Young. The piece is analysis and speculation rather than a report of an agreed deal, laying out the financial questions the Wizards must answer. No extension has been reported as reached.

A trade rumor circulating via The Times of India suggests the Lakers could pursue a former Dallas teammate of Luka Doncic to reunite the pair in Los Angeles. The report is speculative, with no insider attribution or indication that talks have taken place. Treat it as chatter rather than an active negotiation.

A social media post from Tyler Herro has renewed speculation about his future in Miami, according to BasketNews. Nothing concrete has been reported, and no trade talks have been confirmed by the Heat. Treat this as pure speculation driven by the guard's online activity rather than reporting from a league insider.

A hypothetical trade pairing Joel Embiid with Anthony Davis would also reunite Davis with LeBron James in Los Angeles. The idea is described as far from realistic: the Wizards, by all accounts, have shown no interest in moving Davis. This is speculation rather than an active negotiation.

A Heavy.com rumor roundup touches on trade speculation involving LeBron James, James Harden and a possible Bradley Beal fit with Boston. No specific deal has been reported by a named insider, and the items amount to speculation rather than active negotiations. Treat the details as unconfirmed.

A transaction record lists Kristaps Porzingis moving from Atlanta to Golden State. Heading back to the Hawks: Buddy Hield and Jonathan Kuminga. No reporter is credited; this is logged as an official transaction entry.
